47: #define AP_UART0_LOG_LINE_SIZE 256
48: #define AP_UART0_LOG_RETRY_MAX 3
49: #define AP_UART0_LOG_RETRY_MS  10
50: #define AP_UART0_LOG_FLUSH_MS  50
51: 
52: static beken_semaphore_t s_ap_uart0_log_sem;

56: static void ap_uart0_log_output(const uint8_t *line, u16 length)
57: {
58: 	static const uint8_t prefix[] = "ap0: ";
59: 	uint8_t output[sizeof(prefix) - 1 + AP_UART0_LOG_LINE_SIZE];
60: 	u16 output_length;
61: 	u8 retry;
62: 
63: 	memcpy(output, prefix, sizeof(prefix) - 1);
64: 	memcpy(output + sizeof(prefix) - 1, line, length);
65: 	output_length = sizeof(prefix) - 1 + length;
66: 
67: 	for (retry = 0; retry < AP_UART0_LOG_RETRY_MAX; retry++)
68: 	{
69: 		if (shell_log_raw_data(output, output_length))
70: 		{
71: 			return;
72: 		}
73: 
74: 		rtos_delay_milliseconds(AP_UART0_LOG_RETRY_MS);
75: 	}
76: 
77: 	s_ap_uart0_log_write_fail++;
78: }

80: static void ap_uart0_log_rx(void *param)
81: {
82: 	(void)param;
83: 	(void)rtos_set_semaphore(&s_ap_uart0_log_sem);
84: }

86: static void ap_uart0_log_task(beken_thread_arg_t arg)
87: {
88: 	uint8_t input[MB_CHNL_BUFF_LEN];
89: 	uint8_t line[AP_UART0_LOG_LINE_SIZE];
90: 	u16 line_length = 0;
91: 
92: 	(void)arg;
93: 	for (;;)
94: 	{
95: 		u16 input_length;
96: 		u16 index;
97: 		bk_err_t ret;
98: 
99: 		ret = rtos_get_semaphore(&s_ap_uart0_log_sem,
100: 						 line_length ? AP_UART0_LOG_FLUSH_MS : BEKEN_WAIT_FOREVER);
101: 		if (ret == kTimeoutErr)
102: 		{
103: 			ap_uart0_log_output(line, line_length);
104: 			line_length = 0;
105: 			continue;
106: 		}
107: 
108: 		do
109: 		{
110: 			input_length = bk_mb_uart_read(MB_UART0, input, sizeof(input));
111: 			for (index = 0; index < input_length; index++)
112: 			{
113: 				line[line_length++] = input[index];
114: 				if (input[index] == '\n' || line_length == sizeof(line))
115: 				{
116: 					ap_uart0_log_output(line, line_length);
117: 					line_length = 0;
118: 				}
119: 			}
120: 		} while (input_length != 0);
121: 	}
122: }

124: static bk_err_t ap_uart0_log_init(void)
125: {
126: 	bk_err_t ret;
127: 
128: 	ret = rtos_init_semaphore(&s_ap_uart0_log_sem, 1);
129: 	if (ret != BK_OK)
130: 	{
131: 		return ret;
132: 	}
133: 
134: 	ret = rtos_create_thread(&s_ap_uart0_log_thread,
135: 					 BEKEN_DEFAULT_WORKER_PRIORITY,
136: 					 "ap_uart0_log", ap_uart0_log_task, 2048, NULL);
137: 	if (ret != BK_OK)
138: 	{
139: 		rtos_deinit_semaphore(&s_ap_uart0_log_sem);
140: 		return ret;
141: 	}
142: 
143: 	ret = bk_mb_uart_dev_init(MB_UART0);
144: 	if (ret != BK_OK)
145: 	{
146: 		rtos_delete_thread(&s_ap_uart0_log_thread);
147: 		rtos_deinit_semaphore(&s_ap_uart0_log_sem);
148: 		return ret;
149: 	}
150: 
151: 	ret = bk_mb_uart_register_rx_isr(MB_UART0, ap_uart0_log_rx, NULL);
152: 	if (ret != BK_OK)
153: 	{
154: 		bk_mb_uart_dev_deinit(MB_UART0);
155: 		rtos_delete_thread(&s_ap_uart0_log_thread);
156: 		rtos_deinit_semaphore(&s_ap_uart0_log_sem);
157: 		return ret;
158: 	}
159: 
160: 	/* Drain data that may have arrived between channel open and callback
161: 	 * registration. The binary semaphore intentionally coalesces wakeups. */
162: 	(void)rtos_set_semaphore(&s_ap_uart0_log_sem);
163: 	return BK_OK;
164: }

50: static void ap_uart0_log_rx(void *param)
51: {
52: 	(void)param;
53: 	(void)rtos_set_semaphore(&s_ap_uart0_log_sem);
54: }

56: static void ap_uart0_log_task(beken_thread_arg_t arg)
57: {
58: 	uint8_t buffer[MB_CHNL_BUFF_LEN];
59: 
60: 	(void)arg;
61: 	for (;;)
62: 	{
63: 		u16 length;
64: 
65: 		(void)rtos_get_semaphore(&s_ap_uart0_log_sem, BEKEN_WAIT_FOREVER);
66: 		do
67: 		{
68: 			length = bk_mb_uart_read(MB_UART0, buffer, sizeof(buffer));
69: 			if (length != 0)
70: 			{
71: 				if (bk_uart_write_bytes(UART_ID_0, buffer, length) != BK_OK)
72: 				{
73: 					s_ap_uart0_log_write_fail++;
74: 				}
75: 			}
76: 		} while (length != 0);
77: 	}
78: }
79: 
80: static bk_err_t ap_uart0_log_init(void)
81: {
82: 	bk_err_t ret;
83: 
84: 	ret = rtos_init_semaphore(&s_ap_uart0_log_sem, 1);
85: 	if (ret != BK_OK)
86: 	{
87: 		return ret;
88: 	}
89: 
90: 	ret = rtos_create_thread(&s_ap_uart0_log_thread,
91: 					 BEKEN_DEFAULT_WORKER_PRIORITY,
92: 					 "ap_uart0_log", ap_uart0_log_task, 2048, NULL);
93: 	if (ret != BK_OK)
94: 	{
95: 		rtos_deinit_semaphore(&s_ap_uart0_log_sem);
96: 		return ret;
97: 	}
98: 
99: 	ret = bk_mb_uart_dev_init(MB_UART0);
100: 	if (ret != BK_OK)
101: 	{
102: 		rtos_delete_thread(&s_ap_uart0_log_thread);
103: 		rtos_deinit_semaphore(&s_ap_uart0_log_sem);
104: 		return ret;
105: 	}
106: 
107: 	ret = bk_mb_uart_register_rx_isr(MB_UART0, ap_uart0_log_rx, NULL);
108: 	if (ret != BK_OK)
109: 	{
110: 		bk_mb_uart_dev_deinit(MB_UART0);
111: 		rtos_delete_thread(&s_ap_uart0_log_thread);
112: 		rtos_deinit_semaphore(&s_ap_uart0_log_sem);
113: 		return ret;
114: 	}
115: 
116: 	/* Drain data that may have arrived between channel open and callback
117: 	 * registration. The binary semaphore intentionally coalesces wakeups. */
118: 	(void)rtos_set_semaphore(&s_ap_uart0_log_sem);
119: 	return BK_OK;
120: }
